1: Rejoice with us ye brethren in Christ,
For this good luck we possess,
The hour of evil cometh,
That putteth the world in confusion,
O ye sinners repent from sins,
In this Celestial Church.

2: The big ditch of destruction now
opens,
To errupt all its dust,
If thou would not want to perish,
Before Thy Lord and Redeemer,
Cling unto Christ in Celestial Church,
He surely would help you.

3: Shortly, the father would know not
his child,
Nor the child would his father,
Renounce the world now run to Christ
It’s pleasant in His holy place,
Great tumult, destruction cometh,
Come to repentance.

4: I’m patiently waiting in my mercies,
Calling on ye poor sinners,
This hour, come to repentance,
Soon, the mercies would be no more,
Forsake wickedness, sorcery, idol,
Christ surely would save us.

5: The entire world has sinned against
Me
And yet, I regard not this,
I think not of beauty of Heaven
Countable are trands on your head
That made Me Christ bear the suffering,
I say, come, receive life.

6: And for the destruction of this world,
I draw this back with mercy,
And still, unbelief increase,
They worship idols and sorcery,
They indulge in hatred, wickedness,
Forsake them, come to Me.

7: I have prepared many good things for
you,
The shining crown of life,
Your dwelling is waiting for you,
On the suitable, good and  pleasant
land,
Forsake this world and come to Me,
I’ll surely receive you.               Amen

hymns.title: Our Father, the Son, descend now,
hymns.content:
s:m:l:s:d:-
r:m:d:t:l:s:-
r:m:d:f:m:l:r:t:s:m:r:d:

1: Our Father, the Son, descend now,
On the holy throne,
To bring blessing and glory unto thy
children.

2: Heavenly Father in joy dwelleth,
With the host of Angels,
Jesus Christ, our Father does rejoice
with them.

3: Chant ye, Hosanna to our King,

Our Lord God of providence,
He who dwelleth in His holy temple,
And rejoiceth

4: Heavenly Father descend in
goodwill,
And with host of victorious Angels,
And bless this Celestial church with joy

5: Let’s chant Halleluyah to our King,
We all sinners,
Because the spirit of the Lord abides
with us truly.

6: Let us offer thanks to our Lord,
For all His works,
His work is full of miracles on all
creatures.

7: Celestial Church, the Holy Church,
Which I the Lord has blessed,
Is sent to cleanse the sins of the whole
world.

8: Let us sinners repent from our sins,
For judgement is imminent,
This I, the Lord, will
Deliver on all the wicked.    Amen.

1: Let us give thank to the Lord,
Jehovah the Almighty,
Creator of heaven and earth,
Who guideth us till this day.

2: He made the seven Heaven,
And even the seven Earths,
The sun and even moon,
That illuminates us around.

3: He provided food to all creatures,
Even the birds of the air,
Sowing not harvesting not,
Also with beasts of the field.

4: Join us all to praise the Lord,
Whose glory is eternal,
King of evershining light,
King of our victory.

5: Jehovah Holy, Holy, Holy,
Behold us with Thine favour,
And be our guide
In this holy congregation.

6: Jesus Christ our Redeemer,
Bind us with Thy salvation,
That we might be free from sin,
Sake of Thy blood that floweth.

7: Holy Michael our captain,
Defender of all the saints,
Lift thy sword in our defence
To conquer evil spirit.

8: Glory to Father on high,
Glory to His loving Son,
Glory to the Holy Ghost,
Trinity everlasting.                    Amen

hymns.content:

1: Jehovah, Jesus Christ,
Holy Michael our captain,
Celestial is before Thee,
In dread and humble spirit,
Longing for the Holy Ghost,
Beauty of Heavenly grace,
Your blessing and upliftment,
Let them be for us.

2: Be fruitful and multiply,
Your promise for Abraham,
This season the coming year,
Thou would surely have a child,
This Thy promise fo Sarah,

For the barren we plead,
Who look up to Thee Father,
For children like Isaac.

3: In the depth of the Red sea,
Pharaoh and all his army
Perished and rose no more
For Israelites peacefulness,
When all hope was exhausted,
Sea transformed into dry land,
With such great wonderful power,
Lead us safety,

4: The wisdom, knowledge and thy
understanding,
That thou gave to Solomon,
Upliftment and salvation
Like of Joseph and Daniel,
Inspirations from Heaven,
Like of Paul and of Samuel,
El-Morijah who blesses,
Bless us with all these.

5: We are all expecting Thee,
Like the children of promise,
Co-inheriitance of heavnly grace
Everlasting heavenly bliss,
With thy Spirit pilot us,
Bind us with Thy lion of power,
That we work without blemish,
To life everlasting.                   Amen

Blessings the world cannot bestow on
us,

To pathway for the children of Israel,
Open up pathways of good blessing for
us
Do good to us O Lord.

Birds of the air to traffic in
Delicious bread and sumptuous meat,
For Prophet Elijah
By Jordan River, remember us,
Who call upon Thy name
To make provision for our daily needs
In ways mysterious for Thy chosen
ones,
Our King Benefactor.

Elizabeth
The barren now look up to Thee
Give them all with good children,
O King of Providence
Jesus, the King, Holy healer, divine
Heal Thy beloved ones,
That we might sing praises to Thee
always
In Thy Celestial Church,
The giver of all joy.                Amen

hymns.title: Vain thoughts for brethren on earth
hymns.content:
1: Vain thoughts for brethren on earth
Ye my beloved ones,
Be self-assured and yet hardworking.

2: All ye devoted worshipers,
My works are righteous ones
He that is faithful shall be holy.

3: The judgement time is at hand now
Ye my messengers,
Work hard so you might have your
share in heaven,

4: It is your faithful works and love,
That the heavenly Father wants,
For he that is righteous shall be holy.

5: Our dear Lord, the King who saves
Shall save His beloved ones,
Those that abide by His laws shall have
life.

6: There shall be life everlasting,
For those who worked for Him,
Ye brethren prepared to be faithful.
Amen

1: Holy Arch-Angels
Are descending from heaven above,
By the living grace of our Saviour,
They dance around His Holy throne.

2: St Gabriel who stands by the gate,
Praise Him with joyful songs
Let all sing the holy song
And thanksgiving songs to the Lord.

3: Let us all be in one accord,
To give thanks to the Saviour,
Because our Lord lives
And be with us every time.

4: The holy Angel with six wings
Pays homage with two wings
Cover their face with two wings
And praises God with the other two.
Amen

hymns.title: Ye beloved
hymns.content:
s:s:m:f:l:s:-
s:d:d:m:r:l:s:-
m:r:m:f:m:r:d:-

1: Ye beloved
I have come to abide with you
Come closer with joy.

2: Behold the Heavenly Glory
That the host of Angels
Descended for you today.

3: O ye children of My Church
Do My wishes
That the joy may manifest.

4: O ye My choristers
Behold the joy with great glory,
That is given to you today

5: O ye beloved
Sing songs in love
To earn you crown of life.

6: Behold the shining glory
To the entire world
Let the glory shine

7: The glory of Heaven descended
Upon the children
To abide with you today.

8: O ye Celestial Church
Behold the work that was assigned
To you spiritual children.

9: Behold the choristers
That sing Holy to the the King of life
Prove worthy to be with them.

10: Be careful and watchful
Of the glory given you
That it may last forever.

11: Halleluyah is the song
That the host of Angels sing
To praise the Father above.

12: Behold the glorious crown

That the host of Angels
Descended for you children

13: Take care of your position
That have been provided for you
That you may inherit life

14: The position shall be reserved
That is preserved for us
That you may inherit life eternal. Amen

hymns.content:
I
Le Saint Père ordonne du ciel

La Sainte Eglise venue des cieux
Elle sanctifiera le mondeSorciers et méchants trembleront
Sous son éternelle grande puissance
Les Saints Anges se sont réjouis
Mystérieuse est cette dernière barque
Alléluia aux œuvres de l’eternel

II
Le dernier temps est arrivé
Seigneur Jésus-Christ reviendra
Il reviendra juger le monde
Car sa mort sur la croix,
Le sang et l’eau qui ont coulé
De son flanc sacré pour les hommes,
Ne seront point vain sacrifice
Et tous les yeux le verront
Accompagné de ses Saintes Anges

III
Que tous les peuples se repentent
Ce jour sera un jour d’angoisse
Les anges sonneront des trompettes
Rouleront la terre et les cieux
Les océans disparaîtront
Et les morts ressusciteront
Certains pour la joie éternelle
D’autres pour la grande souffrance
En ce jour là les pécheurs trembleront

IV

Et qui auront porté sa croix
Ressusciteront dans la gloire
Ils porteront des robes blanches,
La couronne de gloire sur la tête,
Avec des palmes dans la main
Voleront pour rencontrer Christ
Ils ne seront point fatigués
Alléluia sera leur chant de gloire

L'amour du Père tire à sa fin.

Il n'entendra plus les prières,

Les divisions, maladies, souffrances

Et misères envahiront ce monde.


3.

Le Père hait la perte du pécheur

Il ne veut non plus de sa mort.

Venez à moi; « dit le Rédempteur »

Je vous sauverai vous affligés


4.

Soyez toujours en communion

Pratiquant sans cesse la justice,

Soyez en prière à tout moment

Je resterai toujours avec vous.

hymns.title: Quand sonnera la trompette
hymns.content:
1.

Le pécheur ne résistera pas.
Le livre de vie sera ouvert
Pour vérifier nos œuvres
Le pécheur ne résistera pas.

2.
Ceux dont les œuvres sont valables
Seront revêtus de gloire
Et coiffés d'une couronne d'or
Pour entrer dans la cité
Qu'avait promise Jésus Christ
Le pécheur ne pourra y mettre pied.

3.
Oh quel beau jour se sera
Si nous pouvons déjà croire
A l'appel des saints anges
C'est Jésus qui les envoi
Sur la terre vers les humains
Pour qu'ils soient joyeux au dernier jour

4.
Oh quel beau jour se sera
Si nous pouvons déjà croire
A l'appel des saints anges
Jésus envoya Oshoffa
Vers les hommes de ce monde
Pour entrer dans la joie céleste

Acceptez ce qu'il vous donne (ouvrez lui)

hymns.content:
1.
Place en Dieu ta confiance
Suis toujours le droit chemin
Avec foi, amour constance
Marche en paix vers ton destin
Choisis ton Sauveur pour guide
Obéis à son vouloir
Avec lui du mal perfide
Tu peux vaincre le pouvoir.

Mais un trésor éternel
Auprès de ton divin père
T'est réservé dans le ciel
Si pendant ton court voyage
Il te faut lutter encore
Bientôt de ton héritage
S'ouvrira la porte d'or.

hymns.content:

C'est ton Dieu qui t'a formée
C'est lui seul qui rend vainqueur
Soldats ! à la Sainte guerre
Préparez-vous-en ce jour
(bis) Il faut soumettre la terre
Au roi de paix et d'Amour.

2.

L'Amour du Dieu Tout-Puissant
Dans l'obscurité profonde
Annoncez le jour naissant
Aux peuples sans espérance.
Dites Jésus est venu.

Aux cœurs coupables, et perdus

3.

Auront voulu tout souffrir
Le grand jour fera connaître
L'honneur qui doit les couvrir
Dans l'immortelle victoire
De Jésus le Roi des rois
(bis) Ils auront part à sa Gloire
Ayant eu part à sa Croix

4.
Sur le plus lointain rivage
Cherchez I' Eternelle Croix
Avec un nouveau courage
Partout élevez vos voix
Afin que I' Eglise s'étende
Ici bas, sous tous les cieux
(bis) Et que partout l'on entende
O Christ ton nom glorieux.

hymns.title: L'Eglise du Christianisme Céleste
hymns.content:
HYMNE DU CINQUANTENAIRE SEPTEMBRE 1947

REFRAIN
L'Eglise du Christianisme Céleste
Venue des cieux grâce à l'amour
Que Jésus-Christ
Agneau de Dieu a pour l'humanité

1.
L'Eglise du Christianisme Céleste
Est une Eglise chrétienne
Basée sur la Sainte Bible
Et Jésus-Christ, Roi des rois la dirige
Avec sa puissance divine
Elle est prophétique, évangélique et apostolique.
Et alors Jésus nous tend ses bras
Allons à lui pour le louer

2.
Elle est née le vingt-neuf Septembre mille neuf
Cent quarante-sept au Dahomey actuel Bénin.
Oh quelle bénédiction pour nous pêcheur
Qui cherchons ce vrai salut
Dieu a choisi S.BJ. OSCHOFFA parmi ce Peuple.
Afin que jaillisse du Bénin la lumière
Vers d'autre nations.
Et bien frères le plan du Tout Puissant
est insondable gloire à son nom.

3.
La Sainte Eglise du Christianisme Céleste
Prône chaque fois l'amour et la fraternité.
C'est pourquoi nous devrons unir nos cœurs
Et pensée pour suivre Jésus.
Tout soldat du Christ doit bannir en lui
Les œuvres de la chair.
Afin que dans la dernière barque
Nous soyons tous acceptés.
Frères et sœurs le salut nous attend
Changeons nos cœurs pour être sauvés.

hymns.title: Mi pa kluno me wiwe le
hymns.content:
1.
Mi pa klunọ me wiwé lẹ
N'agùn he jẹté son lon wiwé
Ayajè 'lon ton ma poté
Klunọ we do-é ai
Nado bẹ nokun yì aga
Nọkun hlan 'klunọ dé
Klunọ na dé azọnwàtọ
D'agûn wiwé 'ton mẹ

2.

Mẹ hé bio lẹ wẹ na mo yi

Bọ jibètọ ma su
N'azonwàtọn délẹ sọ gbè
Bo hodo aihọn

Akuẹ yodidé nukunkẹn
Ko hẹn délẹ jai
Ojlo agbasa ton sọ su
Wa sio ylọ Otọ tọn

Gbigbo Wiwe jalé sé miton

Wa na adogbigbo butonọ
Diké mi ni wàzon jẹ podo
7.
Gbigbo wiwé apoe Olon ton
Wa Oto Ovi, Gbigbo wiwé,
Wa kon huhlon lo d'agùn Twé ji
Mi ni do yin agùn gbigbonọ

Wâ no hẹ mi, bo dona mi 'Holu Wiwe

hymns.content:

Miṣẹl wiwe awhàngân,
Gùn Wiwe tin nukon T'we
P'osi po t'ayiha m'ton mẹ
Nukûn do gbigbo Wiwe
Whànpẹ po gigo 'lon ton,
Dona zé d'aga po
Whla yé do mi blo

2.

Pagbé t'we na Ablaham,
T'ojlè he 'whé yoyo mẹ
Na yi 'vi do dona we,
Opagbé he na Salah
Hẹn ṣè na wẹnsino lẹ
He nukün t'we pon 'Kluno
Na yé 'vi d'isaki

3.

Awhànpa Falo ton lẹ
Yin vivà sudo kakayi,
Na gbojè 'vi-Islael ton lẹ
When 'todidô lẹpo vo
Ohù lẹzun-aigbaklo
Gbon huhlon-jawu 'ton mẹ
Yin alihiamẹto

4.

Kẹdẹ di Salomo ton
Zédaga po whlẹgân po
Josef, Daniẹli ton
Tita hinhon towe ton
Di Samuẹl po Paul po ton
Elmolijah donano
Yi do dona mi

5.

Kedẹdi 'vi pagbé ton
Mi ni nopo do dùgu
Gbẹmadopodo 'lon ton
Gbigbo t'we lihiamẹto
Blagbaja huhlon T'we ton
Na m'n'do wà'zon dodo mẹ
Kakajẹ podo

hymns.content:

Jègbakun tin to ta yeton
Dezàn to alo yéton mẹ,
Yé na zlon do pé Klist' yéton
Nusiko ma na tin na yé,
Halleluyah wẹ ohàn yéton lẹ

hymns.title: Kluno son whewhewhenu
hymns.content:
Kluno son whẹwhẹwhenu A ko tin
Hiẹ wẹ Jiyẹwhe Ablaham ton,
Mose, Isaac, Jacob
P'Oshoffa po ton,
Mi zé 'gbè miton lẹ d'aga hlan We
Jalé sé 'vègbè m'ton,
Hẹn-afo m'ton do te
Diké mi yi son dewe gbede blo,
Na 'hàngbè vivi mi
Na mi n'do pa We,
Halleluyah wẹ 'hàn miton t'egbe

hymns.content:

Jalé kon dona Towe deji susu gégé

hymns.title: Okluno na basi
hymns.content:
1.
Okluno na basi,
Na matindo m'ton lẹ
Mẹh' ma jivi na ji,
Mẹh' ji 'ton na mo zé
Okluno na basi,
Azon dagbe na mi
Oji m'ton lẹ na jè,
Mi naso m'ajo wà

Bẹji:

Aholu nupopowàto
Flin do'vo wẹ
Gigo-aihon ton
Po-azon eton lẹ po

Kaka mi na do pli

2.

Jijoho na d'ahol'
Awutuno na fon,
Gbèga na yin miton
Koso ylankan n'no la,

Jiku na d'alote,
Angel' ton na homi

hymns.content:
1.
David ma do n'de hu-akoto 'npé
Nado ho avùn h'asuka nẹ
T'ayiha yopo-eton ton mẹ
Wẹ yise he pẹnzin hẹn ado do
Ado gboe do Okluno go
Na g'alo nado ho-avun hẹ
Do whlẹn Islaẹl

2.
Dedo blẹo dèdè jeyi
Dawe asuka goyito ji
Mẹhe nukun eton gona
Wangbèna po zédaga vlẹko po
Vivlẹ 'vivulo po Klist' po
Ma yonẹn do 'To ko de
David na whlẹn-Islael

3.
Masiso po 'dẹndido po mẹ
Vivu he 'Kluno to dido
Yin hlan adanto lo basi
Alan ma kü de mowẹ 'Kluno lo
To jlo wiwe daho-eton mẹ
Do winyan dawe goyito
Do Whlẹn-Islaẹli

4.

D'avun daho-aihon ton kon
Nado lunton yẹyi T'we mẹ
Di Davidi na tonusisé mi
Yẹn naso mo 'Kluno tin
Sẹpo mi dilé-A basi
Do whlẹn Islaẹli

hymns.content:

Dopo dopo

1.
Nonvi jaya to klisti mẹ
Kudo ta dagbe didò
Jlẹ ylankan lo wa dinvie
Ena hunzo do aihon
Ylanno lẹnnupon bo vo jo
T'agùn wiwe he mẹ

2.
Odò lo dinvie hun do nuvo
Finfon daho de na fon
Yin-ama jlo na yin mẹ dindon
Dè pete do whlẹnganto de
Tè do Klist' go t'agùn lo mẹ
Ena go-alo na we

3.
Zande 'to mana yon ovi eton
Kavi ovi 'to eton
Jo-aihon do honsu Klist dinvié
E to te sô wiwe lo ji
Bèwlu husudo daho de ja
Yawu lẹn bo vo jo

4.
Yẹn gbẹ so po to te lẹblanu mẹ
Yiylo yéw' mẹylankan lẹ
Mi lẹnvojo na jlẹ lo wa
Zande lẹblan'hon lo na su
Jo 'ka azé vodun mawe do
Yẹn to te na whlẹn we

5.
Aihon lo ko wà ylan do mi
Ganso yẹn ma hopon
Ma ho whanpè Olon ton pon
Na hihia wẹ 'da he to ta
Wẹ hẹn yẹn Klisti jiya lo
Yẹn wẹ, wâ de bo gan

6.
Na viva aihon he ton wutu
Lẹblanu don-ẹn do godo
Ganso ma yise lo so su
Yé gbẹ so to vodun sèn
T'azé nuvẹhun po ka po mẹ
Jo po do bo wâ de-E

7.

Jègbakun sisẹno lo
Notẹn t'we to te nopon we
T'aigba whanpèno lo ji
J'aihonmẹnü do bo wâ de-E
Nado kuavo na we

1: Baba pa lasẹ lat’ọrun wa,
Ki gbogbo aiye si wariri,
Fun ‘jọ Mimọ, lat’Ọrun wa,
Ijọ yi ni yio wẹ aiye mọ,
Ajẹ , oso, yio wariri,
La’abẹ agbara Mimọ yi,
Awọn Angẹli si kun f’ayọ,
Iyanu, f’ọkọ ikẹhin,
Halleluya fun iṣẹ Oluwa.

2: Igba ikẹhin na ti de,
Kristi Jesu yio pada wa,
Lati wa ṣe ‘dajọ aiye,
Iku Rẹ lori agbelebu,
Ẹjẹ ati omi to nṣan,
Kuro ninu iha Mimọ Rẹ,
Ko gbọdọ lọ sori asan,
Gbogbo oju yio si tun ri,
Pẹlu awọn Angẹli Mimọ Rẹ.

3: Kẹlẹsẹ ronupiwada,
F’ọjọ iwariri nla na,
Awọn Angẹli yio fun ipe,
A o ka ilẹ at’Ọrun,
Okun yio d’ohun airi mọ,
Awọn oku yio ji dide,
Imiran pẹlu ayọ nla,
Imiran pẹlu ijiya,
Ẹlẹsẹ yio wariri lọjọ na.

4: Awọn toku f‘ọrọ Kristi,
Awọn t’o ru agbelebu Rẹ,
Nwọn yio ji pẹlu ogo nla,
A o wọ wọn lasọ ogo,
A o de wọn lade wura,
Mariwo ọpẹ lọwọ wọn,
Nwọn yio fo pade Kristi wọn,
Arẹ ki yio si fun wọn mọ,
Halleluya, li ohun orin wọn.        Amin

hymns.content:

1: Ẹmi Mimọ Olutunu,
Sokale sarin wa,

Irẹ Ọba Olubukun,
Awa nṣe reti Rẹ.

2: Nitoripe Irẹ ni Ọba,
Nla Ọba Olore,
Ọba Ẹmi sọkalẹ wa,
Awa nṣe reti Rẹ.

3: Ọba anu sọkalẹ wa,
Si ‘ju anu wo wa,
Awa ọmọ Rẹ, nwo oju Rẹ,
Silẹkun anu Rẹ.

4: Ọba Mimọ, Ọba Olore,
Baba ‘jọ ọ bukun wa,
Nitoripe Irẹ li Ọba,
T’o bukun ọmọ Rẹ.

5: Ọba anu, Ọba Iye,
Tan ‘mọlẹ Rẹ fun wa,
Irẹ l’Ọba ‘kiki mọlẹ,
Awa nṣe reti Rẹ.

6: Ọba Mimọ Ọba Iye,
Jọwọ wa bukun wa,
Nitoripe  Irọ l’Ọba anu,
Awa nṣe reti Rẹ.

7: Ẹmi Mimọ, Ẹmi Olore,
Awa nṣe reti Rẹ,
Ọba Mimọ sọkalẹ wa,
Wa gunwa sarin wa.                   Amin

hymns.title: Ẹ ba wa yọ, ara ninu Kristi,
hymns.content:
s:d:-d:m:r:d;r:d:l:s:-

s:d;-d:d:m:r:d:r:

1: Ẹ ba wa yọ, ara ninu Kristi,
Fun o ri rere ta ni,
Wakati buburu na de,
Ti o mu aiye yi gbona,
Ẹlẹsẹ ronupiwada,
Ni ijọ Mimọ yi.

2: Ogbun nla si silẹ nisisiyi,
Lati t’eruku jade,
Bo ko ba fẹ jẹni egbe,
Si ọdọ Olugbala Rẹ,
Rọmọ Kristi ‘nu Ijọ Mimọ yi,
Yio ran o lọwọ.

3: Laipẹ, baba ki yio mọ ọmọ,
Tab’ ọmọ mọ baba rẹ,
K’aiye silẹ sa tọ Kristi,
O duro loke Mimọ Rẹ,
Rukerudo ‘parun nla mbọ,
Ya ronupiwada.

4: Mo si tun nduro ninu anu mi,
Npe awọn ẹlẹsẹ,
Wakati yi ẹ pawada,
Laipẹ anu yio dopin,
Fi ‘ka, ajẹ, orisa silẹ,
Kristi yio, gba wa la.

5: Gbogbo ẹkun aiye ti sẹ si mi,
Sibẹ nko bikita,
Nko ro ẹwa ti Ọrun,
Kika ni irun yin,
Lomu Emi Kristi jiya na,
Emi ni, wa, ki o ye.

6: Niti iparun ti aiye yi,
Mo fi anu fa sẹhin,
Sibẹ aigbagbọ npọsi,
Nwọn nsin orisa, ajẹ,
Nwọn lo arakan ati ika,
Fi wọn lẹ wa ‘dọ Mi.

7: Mo ti pese ohun rere fun ọ,
Ade didan iye na,

Bugbe rẹ nduro de ọ,
Lori ilẹ didara na,
F’aiye silẹ, wa sọdọ Mi,
Emi o tẹwọ gba ọ.                Amin

hymns.content:
s:m:l:s:d:-
r:m:d:t:l:s:-
r:m:d:f:m:l:r:t:s:m:r:d:

1: Baba wa, Ọmọ sọkalẹ,
Lori ‘tẹ Mimọ Rẹ.
Lati mu ibukun ati ogo f’ọmọ Rẹ.

2: Baba ọrun mbẹ ninu ayọ,
Pẹlu awọn Angẹli,
Jesu Kristi, Baba wa nyọ pẹlu wọ.

3: Ẹ ke Hossanah si Ọba wa,
Oluwa Olubukun,
T’o mbẹ ninu Tẹmpili Rẹ Mimọ

O si nyọ.

4: Baba wa Ọrun sọkalẹ sire,
Pẹlu awọn Ogun Ọrun,
Awọn si busi ayọ fun Ijọ Mimọ yi.

5: Ẹ ke Halleluya s’Ọba wa,
Awa ẹlẹṣẹ yi,,
Nitoripe Emi Oluwa mbẹ lotitọ.

6: K’ a fọpe fun Ọlọrun wa,
Fun isẹ Rẹ gbogbo
Iyanu ni iṣẹ Rẹ, lori awa ẹda.

7: ‘Jọ Celestial, Ijọ Mimọ,
T’Emi Oluwa bukun,
Nitori ẹṣẹ aiye pọ,
L’a ṣe mu yi wa.

8: K’awa ẹlẹsẹ yiwa pada,
T’ori idajọ wọle,
Lori awọn ẹni ibi, li Emi o ṣe yi.   Amin

1: Ẹ wo gbogbo araiye,
Ohun Ẹlẹda yin,
Ọjọ ‘dajọ sunmọ le,
A o ba yin siro,
Chorus: Gbogbo aiye lo ṣẹ,
Ti wọn si kuna Ogo Rẹ,
Ẹlẹsẹ orukọ Jesu yio gba wa la,
Ko si ọna miran to tọka s’ọrun,
Ẹyin araiye, ẹ yara wa gba Jesu.

2: Ẹjẹ yebiye Jesu,
Lo se tutu ẹṣẹ wa,
Ẹlẹsẹ wẹ ninu rẹ,
A o si gba wa la,
Chorus: Gbogbo aiye lo ṣẹ,
Ti wọn si kuna Ogo Rẹ,
Ẹlẹsẹ orukọ Jesu yio gba wa la,
Ko si ọna miran to tọka s’ọrun,
Ẹyin araiye, ẹ yara wa gba Jesu.

3: Gbogbo wa ni yio duro,
Niwaju Oluwa,
Atewe ati agba,
A o si rojọ wa,
Chorus: Gbogbo aiye lo ṣẹ,
Ti wọn si kuna Ogo Rẹ,
Ẹlẹsẹ orukọ Jesu yio gba wa la,
Ko si ọna miran to tọka s’ọrun,
Ẹyin araiye, ẹ yara wa gba Jesu.

4: Kini iwọ, ati temi yio wi?
Nigbati a o ri Jesu,
Ọpọ enia lo ku,
Ni alaini Jesu,
Chorus: Gbogbo aiye lo ṣẹ,
Ti wọn si kuna Ogo Rẹ,
Ẹlẹsẹ orukọ Jesu yio gba wa la,
Ko si ọna miran to tọka s’ọrun,

1: Ọrọ Oluwa kọ si yin,
Latoke Ọrun wa,
Ẹ mura, kẹ gbọ ipe na,
Kẹ si ri ogo na.

2: Aiye yi yio lọ si opin,
Ohun gbogbo yio tan,
Ẹnikẹni to gbọ ọrọ na,
Yio si ri ogo na.

3: Ijọ Mimọ ẹ tun ra di,
Kẹ le kun aye yin,
Aye ti Jesu wa silẹ,

Tin yin ni yio si jẹ.

4: Ifẹ Oluwa ti pọ to,
S’ẹnyin Ijọ Mimọ.
Ẹ mura kẹ gb’Oluwa gbọ,
Kẹ le ri ogo Rẹ.

5: Ẹyin, aiye ẹ mọ daju,
P’asan laiye yi jẹ,
Ọrọ Oluwa ododo,
Ni yio jẹ nikẹhin.

6: Ade Mimọ t’Emi ti pese,
F’awọn to gba Mi gbọ,
Awọn to gbagbọ yio dade na,
Lati sogo kẹhin.                          Amin

1: Ẹ jẹ ka fọpẹ fun Baba,
Jehovah Olodumare,
Ẹlẹda Ọrun aiye,
To da wa si di oni.

2: On lo da Ọrun meje,
Ati ilẹ meje pẹlu,
Orun ati Osupa,
Ti ntanmọlẹ yi wa ka.

3: O fi onjẹ fun gbogbo ẹda,
Ẹiye iwo to nfo kọja,
Ti ko gbin, ti ko kore,
Ati ẹranko igbẹ.

4: Ẹ ba wa, yin Oluwa,
Ologo ti ko nipẹkun,
Ọba okiki Imọlẹ,
Ọba Olusẹgun wa,

5: Jehovah, Mimọ, Mimọ, Mimọ,
F’oju rere Rẹ wo wa,
Ko si ma samọna wa,
Ninu Ijọ Mimọ yi.

6: Jesu Kristi, Olugbala,
F’ igbala Rẹ kari wa,
Ka bọ ninu ẹsẹ,
Nitori isun eje Re.

7: Michael Mimọ. Balogun wa,
Olugbeja awọn ẹni Mimọ,
Gbe ida rẹ soke fun wa,
Lati sẹgun ẹmi ẹsu.

8: Ogo ni fun Baba l’Ọrun,
Ogo ni fun Ọmọ Rẹ,
Ogo ni fun Ẹmi Mimọ,
Mẹta lọkan aiyeraiye.                  Amin

hymns.content:

1: Jehovah, Jesu Kristi,
Michael Mimọ, ọga ogun,
Ijọ Mimọ mbẹ Niwaju Rẹ,
Tẹru tẹdun ọkan wa,
Lati safẹri Ẹmi Mimọ,
Ẹ wa Ogo Ọrun,
Ibukun ati gbega,
Ma ṣe fi du wa.

2: Ma bi si i, si rẹ si i,
Ileri Rẹ f’Abraham,
Niwoyi ọdun titun,
Iwọ yio f’ọmọ sere,
Ileri yi fun Sarah,

Jọ musẹ f’awọn agan,
Ti nwọn nwọju Rẹ,
F’ọmọ b’Isaki.

3: Ninu okun pupa ni,
Farao at’ogun rẹ,
Parun laigberi mọ,
Fun isimi ọkan Israel,
Nigbati ‘reti dopin,
Okun diyangbẹ ilẹ,
Nipa agbara iyanu yi,
Sin wa de ‘nu iye.

4: Ogbọn, imọ, oye Rẹ,
Gẹgẹbi ti Solomon,
Igbega ati igbala,
Bi ti Josef’ Daniel,
Imisi ati ohun Ọrun,
Bi ti Paul, Samueli,
El-Morijah, Olubukun,
Se nwọn ni ti wa.

5: Awa nṣe ireti Rẹ,
Gẹgẹ b’ọmọ ileri,
Ajọ jumọ jogun iye,
Ainipẹkun, ijọba ọrun,
Wa f’Ẹmi ọrun ṣe atọkọ,
Di wa l’amure agbara,
Ka sisẹ lailabawọn,
Si iye ainipẹkun.                     Amin

hymns.title: Riro ni t’ọmọ araiye,
hymns.content:
1: Riro ni t’ọmọ araiye,
Ẹnyin iransẹ Mi,
Tujuka kẹ ‘tẹra mọ iṣẹ Mi,

2: Ẹnyin Olusin otitọ,
Otitọ ni ‘sẹ Mi,
Ẹni to ba s’otitọ yio mọ.

3: Igba ikẹhin na sunmọ le,
Ẹnyin ojisẹ Mi,
Ẹ mura kẹ le wọ ipo yin l’ọrun.

4: Isẹ otitọ ati ifẹ,
Ni Baba lọrun fẹ,
Ẹnyin to ba si sotitọ yio mọ.

5: Oluwa Ọba igbala,

Yio gba awoọ tiẹ la,
Awọn to ba si p’ofin mọ yio la.

6: Iye ainipẹkun yio wa,
F’awọn onisẹ Rẹ,
Ẹ mura kẹ si s’otitọ aiye.            Amin

Ẹ mura sẹsin yin,

Kuro ninu egbe.                           Amin

1: Ẹyin anyanfẹ Mi
Mo de lati ba yin gbe,
Ẹ fi ayọ sunmọ Mi

2: Ẹ wo Ogo Ọrun
Ti awọn maleka
Sọkalẹ fun yin loni

3: Ẹnyin omo Ijọ mi
Ẹ ṣe ifẹ temi
Kayọ na le di mimọ

4: Ẹnyin akọrin mi
Wo ayọ to logo
Ti a gbe fun yin loni

5: Ẹnyin ayanfẹ Mi
Ẹ kọrin ninu ifẹ
Ki ẹ le gbade iye

6: Ẹ wo ogo na ntan
Si gbogbo agbaye
Ẹ jẹ kogo na le tan

7: Ogo Ọrun sọkalẹ
Lati ba ẹnyin ọmọ
Gbe li ọjọ oni

8: Ẹnyin Ijọ Mimọ
Wo iṣẹ ta gbe le ẹnyin
Ọmọ ẹmi lọwọ

Ti nkọ mimọ sọba Iye
Ẹ jẹ ka ka yin mọ wọn,

Ẹ wogo ta fun yin
Ki o le ba yin kalẹ

Tawọn maleka nkọ

Ti awọn maleka
Sọkalẹ fun ẹnyin ọmọ.

Ti a ti pe yin si
Kẹ le jogun iye

Ka le jogun iye.                         Amin

Pẹlu ‘dapọ mimọ.

Itẹriba mimọ.

Ero buburu ko dara,

Ẹ sin Oluwa pẹlu ifẹ,
Pẹlu ifẹ l’awọn Angẹli,

Fi sin Baba l’ọrun.                         Amin
